hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.blade\.php$'; then VIOLATIONS=$(grep -nP '<(input|select|textarea)(\s|>|/)' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'x-form-inputs\|x-form_inputs\|@props\|<!--' || true); if [ -n "$VIOLATIONS" ]; then echo "⚠️  RAW HTML INPUT en $FILE — usar x-form-inputs.text_input / input / select / textarea:"; echo "$VIOLATIONS"; fi; fi
